name: hash the message under an inner key, then hash that result under an outer key
mechanism: XOR the key with one fixed pad and prepend it to the message, hash; XOR the key with a second pad, prepend it to that digest, hash again; the outer hash blocks anyone from extending the inner one, so a tag cannot be forged without the key even if the hash alone is extensible

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'HMAC' in section Computer science / Cryptography: keyed-hash message authentication

fails_when: two hash passes over the key material; only as strong as the hash's compression
